about: Four-player split screen (docs/split4.md), applied by regen.sh (tools.recomp --relocate, toolkit tools/recomp/relocate.py). Each entry moves one of the title's fixed two-slot player arrays into the block the runtime reserves right after the image (src/game/split4/core.c, 0x00780000 for the USA executable): every immediate and displacement inside [lo, hi) becomes to + (v - lo); with base, also a register-relative displacement in [lo - base, hi - base); a cmp against hi (a loop's end) becomes to + size. The targets must match src/game/split4/split4.h. "immediates": loop counts written for two players, raised to four (every slot is built and set up; the stage decides how many race).

relocations.name: humans
relocations.note: The race world's human racers (world 0x60EA00 + 0x12B7D0, stride 0x27E0, two slots; the AI racers follow at + 0x130790). Built by sub_001AACB0 from the stage's player count, constructed (vtable 0x3B11A0) by sub_001A9930. Four slots of 0x27E0.

relocations.name: setup
relocations.note: The player setup records (0x24 each, two slots: +0 the controller record, 0x4AE724 + 0x188 n, whose pad the car drives with; +0x18 its number; +0x1C, +0x20), filled by the stage set-up (sub_000209A0, unrolled) and the app's (0x4A71A0 + 0x28930: sub_00015A60, sub_00015F10, sub_000165F0, hence the base) and pointed to by each human racer's +0x2470 (sub_001AACB0: 0x4CFAD0 + 0x24 x player). Four slots.

relocations.name: cameras
relocations.note: The players' cameras (vtable call +0xC; app 0x4A71A0 + 0x28980, 0xC50 each, two slots; indexed by the human's +0x27D0). Built by the app constructor (0x157D3: mov ebx, 2 / sub_00015900). The third camera object right after them (0x4D13C0) is reached only by fixed addresses (256 sites) and stays where it is. Four slots.

relocations.name: camdata
relocations.note: Per-player camera data in the race world (world + 0x128D10, 0x1050 each, two slots; indexed by the player camera's +0xC30). Four slots.

relocations.name: viewdata
relocations.note: Per-view data in the race world (world + 0x12ADC8, 0x1CC each, two slots; indexed by the human's +0x27D0, an object's view byte +0x217, the stage render's view index; 1 - index is 'the other player' at 0x109DB8 and 0x11A6A6). A third record follows (0x739B60) reached only by fixed addresses; it stays. Four slots.

relocations.name: carptr
relocations.note: A per-player dword in the race world (world + 0x12B258, two entries; sub_0018C470 stores the car's model pointer at [player * 4 + 0x739C58], set to 0 by the world init 0x1A9CE7). Player 3's entry would be the vtable of world + 0x12B260. Four entries.

relocations.name: physics
relocations.note: The human cars' physics objects in the simulation (world + 0x3C910 = 0x64B310, + 0x1CB80, 0x4AD0 each, two slots; the AI cars' follow at + 0x26120). Its offsets are used by other structures too, so the object-relative rule applies only at the listed sites (sub_00110280, sub_00110420, sub_00111230, the world constructor's sub_001A99F0, sub_0001A8F0: a human's physics object by its index, used by the car update sub_0018C510). Four slots.

immediates.note: The app constructor builds the players' cameras: mov ebx, 2 (sub_00015900 for each).
The world constructor builds the human cars' physics objects: mov edi, 2.
The simulation's init sets up the human cars' physics: mov edi, 2 (sub_00117730 each).
The world's init sets up the human racers (player index, sub_001705F0): cmp ecx, 2.

The track streamer's focus loop (sub_001A20F0) walks the human slots into two-entry locals (esp+0x28 words, esp+0x30 pointers, the count 2 at esp+0x2C between them): it stays at two foci, players 1 and 2 (the end of slot 2 in the relocated block: 0x780000 + 2 x 0x27E0). Known limitation: track around players 3 and 4 streams only as far as it does around 1 and 2.
